def _parse_def_item(block: 'BlockParser', m: Match[str]) ->Iterable[Dict[
    str, Any]]:
    head = m.group('def_list_head')
    # Split the head into individual terms
    terms = [term for term in head.strip().split('\n') if term.strip()]
    
    # Process each term
    for term in terms:
        yield {
            'type': 'def_list_head',
            'children': _process_text(block, term, False),
        }
    
    # Find all definition descriptions following the terms
    src = m.group(0)
    dd_matches = DD_START_RE.split(src)
    # Skip the first element which is the header part
    if len(dd_matches) > 1:
        for dd_content in dd_matches[1:]:
            if dd_content.strip():
                yield {
                    'type': 'def_list_item',
                    'children': _process_text(block, dd_content, False),
                }
